scientific_question: Does the already-frozen v140 ordered-pair, six-depth-bin, two-angle representation close the fixed v139 active tail and therefore the complete 3700-cell, five-trajectory truth-aware capacity gate without changing the 2A+2AT online shell?

stage_a.meaning: Stage A authorizes only this frozen Stage B. It is not full capacity or a deployable predictor.

stage_b.roster_definition: Every sample for which any independently validated v139 selected metric divided by its zero-start CGLS K4 reference exceeds 1.02.
stage_b.inactive_parent_retention: Every sample outside the active tail retains its independently validated v139 candidate without recomputation or reselection.
stage_b.candidate_roster: v139 parent, all six finite projection weights, projection-only endpoint, and the deployment-visible pair-depth joint-LS control.
stage_b.per_cell_selection: Use the unchanged v140 selector and 1.05 per-cell four-metric limit.
stage_b.pass_rule: After replacing exactly the 2199 active-tail rows and retaining exactly the 1501 inactive v139 rows, all 3700 cells must pass the 1.05 four-metric gate and each complete trajectory must pass every p90-higher<=1.02 and worst<=1.05 gate.
stage_b.failure_action: Record the exact failing cells and tails, close this representation, and do not rescue it with a larger predictor or neural model.
stage_b.success_action: Authorize only a separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only predictor under complete-trajectory LOTO.

stage_b_roster.canonical_encoding: Strictly increasing global sample indices encoded as little-endian signed int32 C-order bytes.

representation_contract.parent_basis: Exactly the complete v139 72C direction prefix.
representation_contract.pair_basis: Exactly 24C(C-1) ordered target-peer directions from 12 target-ray samples, six fixed two-sample depth bins, two signed angle branches and the frozen low-low target carrier.
representation_contract.visible_inputs: Active-camera zero-start CGLS K1 residual, predicted correction dual and all reported 18-value camera tokens.

objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of regularized normal equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize coefficients to unit RMS and orient toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.selector: Prefer all-four-metric feasibility by minimum worst ratio, then observation ratio and roster order; otherwise physical feasibility and minimum observation; otherwise physical minimax.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets, four metrics and selector use only already-opened fit truth to measure finite-roster representation capacity.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible pair-depth residual joint ridge LS
cheap_control.stage_b_scope: Replay on all 2199 active-tail cells as a diagnostic control; Stage-A failure already proves it cannot satisfy the complete gate.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact AT lift and one exact A projection
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: Truth-aware direction lifts, seven solves and scoring are excluded from any deployment or speed claim.

decision_rule.stage_b_pass: Only after 3700/3700 cells and 5/5 complete trajectory tails pass under independent recomputation may a separately frozen minimal predictor be implemented.
decision_rule.stage_b_fail: Close this exact pair-resolved representation and report the fixed failure strata; no larger network is authorized.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Full truth-aware capacity is not observation-only prediction, wall/RSS speedup, external generalization, curved-ray validation, real BOST or paper success.
